title: Empirical influential coordinates from inputs
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $f$ be a Boolean function from length-$n$ sign vectors to signs, let $t$ be a positive rational influence bound, and let $\varepsilon$ be a rational with $0<\varepsilon\le 1/2$. Given, for every singleton coordinate set, a prescribed-length list of input sign vectors, form the empirical influential-coordinate set using the sample pairs consisting of each input and its value under $f$.
